The '''Rori Stadium''' was a sports arena on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Rori/Legends|Rori]], in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Nuna-ball/Legends|Nuna-ball]] was among the sports venues arranged there.

==Behind the scenes==
The Rori Stadium was first mentioned in the [[Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)|''Champions of the Force'']] set of the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]''. "Rori Stadium" can be translated from [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] text on the "Nuna-Ball Advertisement" card.
